decisions.reason: The LED ceiling luminaire remains closely aligned with the firm's core design-led lighting range and broad portfolio strategy, so despite normal range pruning the case for keeping it is still strong.
The flexible LED spotlight fits the firm's established emphasis on adaptable lighting solutions and was given a full product page at launch, which suggests commitment beyond a short test phase.
The multi-outlet ceiling canopy extends the firm's modular system offer and supports installers and planners, making it a useful complement that is unlikely to be withdrawn quickly.
The low-voltage multi-outlet canopy also strengthens the system architecture of the range, though its more specific application gives it a somewhat higher withdrawal risk than the core luminaires.

The round glass track luminaires suit the firm's design-oriented positioning, but because they were only mentioned rather than strongly featured on the website, they carry the highest risk of later portfolio rationalisation.
